review:
A crime caper in a small American town – cash, maps, handcuffs and detectives. Pragmatic describes it as full of features, with bandits around every corner.

The provider's page doesn't explain the features, but the in-game screens advertise up to 5,000x. The RTP is 96.3%, a bit under Pragmatic's usual top. The demo is the best way to find out how it works – good if you like discovering a game as you play.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
